subject: Urban Planning
title: Grenfell Tower: When Safety Codes Fail
description: A quick win: understand Grenfell Tower: When Safety Codes Fail.

hook.text: On June 14, 2017, Grenfell Tower in London caught fire. 72 people died. The cladding was supposed to be safe.

buildup.text: The tower was clad with aluminum composite panels to make it look nicer from the outside. They were flammable.

discovery.text: Residents had warned the management company for years about fire safety. Every complaint was ignored.

twist.text: The government had deregulated building inspections to cut costs. Private firms replaced public inspectors.

climax.text: An inquiry found systemic failures. 400+ buildings in the UK still have similar dangerous cladding today.

punchline.text: They made the building look better. They made it deadly.

quiz.question: What caused the rapid spread of fire at Grenfell Tower?
options: Faulty electrical wiring throughout the building
Flammable aluminum composite cladding on the exterior
A gas leak in the basement that exploded during the fire
